scope: Representative current-source consolidation and existing specification review; no production inspection, new browser/AT audit, code changes or new tests.
priority_note: Impact is not roadmap priority or claimable readiness.
wcag_note: WCAG 2.2 references are guidance only; no conformance assessment claimed. Product 44px targets/14px text conventions are not themselves WCAG compliance.

findings.title: Roster changes can be discarded through inconsistent dialog close paths
findings.recommendation: Use one dirty/saving dismissal path for Close, Cancel, Escape and backdrop; keep edits after failure.
findings.acceptance: Keep editing preserves exact permitted input and focus; only successful save or deliberate discard resets.

findings.title: Announcement and schedule editors need consistent unsaved-work recovery
findings.recommendation: Track all edited content and attachments; separate save, publication, approval and sending.
findings.acceptance: Every dismissal/editor switch preserves dirty work or asks for explicit discard; failed saves retain content.

findings.title: Account amount-due and next-event projections do not consistently honor registration lifecycle
findings.recommendation: Reuse lifecycle-aware payable-state projections; keep historical money separately visible.
findings.acceptance: Cancelled/refunded and waitlisted records have accurate non-payable meaning; cancelled records do not become active next-event recommendations.

findings.title: Public event addresses and embed code use unsaved draft settings
findings.recommendation: Build public outputs from persisted saved settings; label draft preview separately.
findings.acceptance: Unsaved/failed-save slug edits leave public outputs intact; successful save updates them; clipboard failure remains recoverable.

findings.title: Report email action silently truncates registration selection to 250
findings.recommendation: Disclose matched/selected/omitted counts while preserving existing limit and reviewed send semantics.
findings.acceptance: 250/251 cases make scope explicit; reviewed recipients exactly match the bounded selection; shared-address registration semantics stay intact.

findings.title: Merchandise editors omit shared dialog keyboard handling; audience preview can mislabel stale results
findings.recommendation: Apply shared dialog behavior and tie preview results to evaluated audience with loading/error states.
findings.acceptance: Tab/Escape/focus return work; failed/out-of-order responses cannot display previous results as current audience.

findings.title: Registration order note can disagree with active server sort
findings.recommendation: Render readable order from effective canonical sort.
findings.acceptance: Name ascending and submitted ascending/descending notes match actual results without changing query ordering.

findings.title: Saved device queue and arrival row use contradictory check-in labels
findings.recommendation: Use one truthful vocabulary for local save, retry, review and server confirmation; align screening guidance with delivered policy.
findings.acceptance: Offline saved row and queue agree; announcements and confirmed counts never imply local queue equals arrival confirmation.

findings.title: Crowded calendar day lacks a direct action to all its items
findings.recommendation: Use a full-date View all action leading to complete dated agenda while preserving filters.
findings.acceptance: Five-item day exposes all five; category/month remain; phone dots stay noninteractive and agenda remains usable.

findings.title: Finder underexplains supported search and map coverage
findings.recommendation: Name town/ZIP/club/church search; show result/map counts, Clear search and honest unavailable states.
findings.acceptance: Unmapped clubs remain list results; no-match recovery and status feedback work without adding private public fields.

findings.title: Staff invitation tables overflow at intermediate 861px width without scroll cue
findings.recommendation: Use suitable cards or shared discoverable horizontal-scroll pattern at affected widths.
findings.acceptance: Affected eight-width audit and keyboard checks keep data/actions reachable.

findings.title: Task columns and visibly labelled roster actions can reduce scanning and memorization
findings.recommendation: Preserve populations and current permissions; use stable-ID task columns and visible Edit/Actions vocabulary.
findings.acceptance: Phone cards retain labels/sort; reset works; no protected access is gained through column choice.

findings.title: System/Event context, settings impact and task help need consistent accepted presentation
findings.recommendation: Preserve accepted menu, actual grants and distinct role shells; give context, consequence and task help without losing work.
findings.acceptance: New/limited-role users can identify scope, find authorized help and return; learning does not imply operational approval.

findings.title: Public page/content/form/sharing workflow needs a connected organizer presentation
findings.recommendation: Connect existing editors and previews within accepted event scope; keep saved/public/draft/private links distinct.
findings.acceptance: State/device previews are labelled and share correct rules; no extra System menu or premature multi-page builder is inferred.

existing_strengths: Native Actions disclosure and visible trigger focus return
Sortable column aria-sort and readable order notes
Event-settings first-error focus and independent save/publish controls
